plugin.note: The best spot is the level 53 ogres west of Yanille, where you can safespot behind the stone wall and/or use a Dragon cannon. Ogres attack with crush, have low Defence, and are 20% weak to earth spells, so any combat style works. Zogres and Skogres at Jiggig require brutal arrows and can inflict disease.

mechanics: Ogres are assigned only by Vannaka (40-90) at combat level 40; there is no Slayer level or quest requirement for the task itself, and no extended range.
Ogres are most commonly found in Kandarin.
Along with ogres, Ogress Warriors and Ogress Shamans, Mogres, Zogres, and Skogres all count towards the task. Jogres do NOT count.
Zogres and Skogres have a lower combat level but can inflict disease, so take caution; brutal arrows work best against them.

Individual variants carry their own access requirements: Mogres need 32 Slayer (and Skippy and the Mogres / Fishing explosives), Ogresses need The Corsair Curse progress or 10 Agility, and Zogres/Skogres need Zogre Flesh Eaters progress.
Players with 41 Magic can use ensouled ogre heads to cast Adept Reanimation and kill reanimated ogres.
The infobox id field is 'No', so this task has no SLAYER_TARGET id (slayerTargetId left null).

methods.label: Brutal arrows against zogres and skogres
methods.summary: Use a compatible ogre bow and brutal arrows; normal attacks suffer damage reduction. Bring disease treatment for Jiggig.
steps: Finish the required Zogre Flesh Eaters access steps.
Use brutal arrows with an ogre bow; carry a Relicym's balm for disease.

requiredItems.name: Comp ogre bow or Ogre bow
Rune brutal or Adamant brutal or Mithril brutal

methods.label: Chaos Druid Tower Dungeon
steps: Level 53 ogres; requires 46 Thieving. This location is fairly unpopulated.

methods.label: Clock Tower Dungeon
steps: Level 53 ogres.

methods.label: Combat Training Camp
steps: Level 63 ogres. Requires completion of Biohazard.

methods.label: Corsair Cove Dungeon
steps: Ogress Warriors and Ogress Shamans (level 82). The entrance is a commonly used safespot, so expect not to be able to use it. Ogress shamans offer a unique cosmetic drop.

methods.label: Feldip Hills
steps: Level 53 ogres; fairly spread out.

methods.label: Gnome Maze
steps: Single level 53 ogre spawn.

methods.label: God Wars Dungeon
steps: Level 58 ogres. As this is a multicombat area, other monsters will attack you.
The wiki lists this spot as cannonable, but God Wars Dungeon inhabitants can destroy a placed cannon.

methods.label: Gu'Tanoth
steps: Level 53 ogres; requires partial completion of Watchtower. The ogres in this area are secluded in many areas.

methods.label: Jiggig
steps: Zogres and Skogres (level 44). Brutal arrows work best against Zogres and Skogres.

methods.label: Jiggig Dungeon
steps: Zogres and Skogres (level 44). Brutal arrows work best against Zogres and Skogres.

methods.label: Mudskipper Point
steps: Mogres (level 60). Fishing explosives are required to engage in combat with Mogres.

methods.label: Underground Pass (dungeon)
steps: Level 53 ogres. Requires completion of Plague City.

methods.label: West of Yanille
steps: Level 53 ogres; the recommended place to kill ogres for the task. Can be safespotted behind the stone wall.

methods.label: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
steps: Single level 58 ogre. As this is a multicombat Wilderness area, other monsters and players will attack you.
The wiki lists this spot as cannonable, but God Wars Dungeon inhabitants can destroy a placed cannon.

methods.label: Witchaven Dungeon
steps: Level 53 ogres.
